description: This Java class implements a factory for creating and managing DeviceConnectionClient instances within the Eclipse Hono framework, handling connection lifecycle, client creation, and timeout events.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing DeviceConnectionClient instances, handling connection lifecycle and tenant timeout events.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with an existing HonoConnection and sets up event bus consumer for tenant timeout.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Clears the client cache when the connection is disconnected.

methods.name: getOrCreateDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Returns a Future that resolves to a DeviceConnectionClient for the specified tenant ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: removeDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the given tenant ID from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing the associated client.
